note: The loop counter i is incremented without any bounds check against MS_MAXPROJARGS (20). Each MS_STRING or MS_AUTO token in the PROJECTION block writes a heap-allocated string pointer into p->args[i].
i is incremented after each token. When more than 20 string tokens are provided in the PROJECTION block, i exceeds the bounds of the args array.
On the 21st iteration (i=20), the write to p->args[20] occurs past the end of the args array (declared with MS_MAXPROJARGS=20 elements), causing a heap-buffer-overflow write.
The out-of-bounds write corrupts adjacent heap memory. The vulnerability is triggered by a mapfile containing a PROJECTION block with more than 20 quoted string tokens.
